'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of Syria (2024–present)|Israeli invasion of Syria]]
***[[Israeli Air Force|Israeli warplanes]] carry out airstrikes on defense factories and a research center in [[Al-Safira]], [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://english.news.cn/20250103/755c955446c44a73a4034e7ca9c6efde/c.html (Xinhua)]
**[[US intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***According to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]], [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. forces]] are deploying a new convoy to areas controlled by the [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] in [[Kobani]], Aleppo Governorate, as part of operations to establish a new [[List of American military installations|US military base]] in north-eastern Syria. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/352729/ (SOHR)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***Eleven people are killed, including a [[Hamas]] police chief, in an [[Israel]]i airstrike on a [[Palestinian refugee camp|refugee camp]] in [[Al-Mawasi, Rafah|al-Mawasi]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cq62dver40yo (BBC News)]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s office announces that it has approved a delegation to [[Doha]], [[Qatar]] for [[ceasefire]] talks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-delegation-resume-ceasefire-talks-doha-pms-office-says-2025-01-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]], [[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland Security Force|Puntland forces]] conduct airstrikes on [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|ISIL]] hideouts in [[Bari, Somalia|Bari]], [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]], after they announced a military offensive against ISIL and [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]]. [https://www.idilnews.com/puntland-forces-conduct-airstrikes-on-isis-positions-in-bari-region/ (Idil News)] [https://www.voasomali.com/a/puntland-oo-sheegatay-duqeyn-ka-dhan-ah-daacish/7922007.html (VOA)]
*[[2025 New Orleans truck attack]], [[Trump International Hotel Las Vegas Tesla Cybertruck explosion|2025 Las Vegas Trump Hotel bombing]]
**[[Christopher Raia]], the deputy assistant director of the [[FBI]]'s counterterrorism division, says he believes that there is "no definitive link" between the two alleged [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. Army]] servicemen perpetrators of the attacks, Shamsud-Din Jabbar in New Orleans and Matthew Alan Livelsberger in Las Vegas. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/crl378x8nnjo (BBC)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**A wave of attacks since two days ago against police in [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]], results in the killing of two perpetrators and one officer. [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/mindanao/attacks-cops-new-year-eve-december-31-2024/ (Rappler)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**The [[Handelsblatt|Handelsblatt Research Institute]] reports that the [[Economy of Germany|German economy]] is in its "greatest crisis in [[History of Germany (1990–present)|post-war history]]" after projecting that the economy will enter its third year of [[recession]] in 2025 with a 0.1% contraction, following a 0.3% contraction in both 2023 and 2024. [https://tvpworld.com/84331034/german-recession-projected-to-enter-its-third-year (TVP World)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven people are killed and 31 injured after a truck crashed in [[Gombe State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://dailypost.ng/2025/01/03/seven-dead-31-injured-in-gombe-auto-crash-frsc/ (Daily Post)]
*Five people are killed after two vehicles collided in [[Bajhang District]], [[Nepal]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20250103/3784ef3990614ac780f57c38c4c64c12/c.html (Xinhua)]
*A small plane crashes through the roof of a commercial warehouse in [[Fullerton, California|Fullerton]], [[California]], [[United States]], causing a fire, killing two people and injuring at least 18 others. [https://abc7.com/post/small-plane-crashes-fullerton-resulting-4-alarm-fire-police-say/15742833/ (KABC-TV)] [https://apnews.com/article/california-plane-crash-fullerton-08ec23f1c117be7bc07fc9b8f4064f91 (AP)]
* Two officers were injured in an explosion of an unknown object at a police fence in [[Berlin-Wittenau]]; the reasons for this are still unclear. [https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/regional/berlin/polizisten-explosion-verletzungen-berlin-100.html (''tagesschau'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Iran–Italy relations]]
**[[Italy]] summons [[Iran]]'s ambassador to demand the release of ''[[Il Foglio]]'' reporter [[Cecilia Sala]], [[List of foreign nationals detained in Iran|detained]] in [[Tehran]] for alleged legal violations. [https://apnews.com/article/italy-iran-journalist-arrest-ambassador-6656e7f9df9db8b7216a180d69dde52c (AP)]
*[[Syria–Ukraine relations]]
**[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that [[Ukraine]] will pledge support to the [[First Syrian transitional government|Syrian transitional government]]. [https://www.pressdemocrat.com/article/news/middle-east-latest-ukraine-pledges-support-for-a-new-syria-once-a-key-rus/ (''The Press Democrat'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**The [[Government of Venezuela|government]] of [[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan president]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] offers a [[United States dollar|US$]]100,000 reward for the capture of exiled opposition leader [[Edmundo González Urrutia]], who claims that he is ready to take office as the legitimate president on January 10. [https://www.eluniversal.com/politica/198116/gobierno-nacional-ofrece-recompensa-de-100000-por-la-captura-de-edmundo-gonzalez-urrutia (''El Universal'')] [https://elpais.com/america/2024-11-25/edmundo-gonzalez-asegura-que-tomara-posesion-como-presidente-el-10-de-enero-en-caracas.html (''El País'')]
*[[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian president]] [[Daniel Noboa]] decrees the suspension of his [[Vice President of Ecuador|vice president]] [[Verónica Abad]] accusing her of contempt, and the handover of her functions to national planning secretary [[Sariha Moya]]. Noboa already appointed Moya to replace Abad in November 2024, but a [[Constitutional Court of Ecuador|constitutional judge]] reversed the decree in December. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/spa/noboa-vuelve-a-designar-vice-interina-de-ecuador-en-medio-de-pugna-con-abad/88668546 (Swiss Info)]
*The [[Parliament of Ghana]] prevents a potential [[government shutdown]] by approving a provisional [[Government budget|budget]] of [[Ghanaian cedi|₵]]68.1 billion ($4.65 billion) to fund [[Government of Ghana|government]] operations through March, amid a transition to [[John Mahama]]'s [[Presidency of John Mahama|presidency]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ghanas-parliament-passes-provisional-budget-averts-government-shutdown-2025-01-03/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Constitutional Court of Indonesia]] rules that the 20% [[electoral threshold]] for [[List of political parties in Indonesia|political parties]] to nominate a [[President of Indonesia|presidential]] candidate is not legally binding, potentially enabling smaller parties to participate in future presidential [[Elections in Indonesia|elections]] without the need to form coalition with larger parties. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-court-says-vote-threshold-presidential-candidates-not-legally-binding-2025-01-02/ (Reuters)]
*The [[President of Chile|Chilean president]], [[Gabriel Boric]], begins a historic three-day trip to [[Antarctica]] along with civil, scientific and military authorities. According to the Chilean Government, the codenamed ''Operación Estrella Polar III'' seeks to strengthen the country's presence in the territory. [https://www.gob.cl/noticias/presidente-gabriel-boric-realiza-historico-viaje-polo-sur-operacion-estrella-polar/ (Government of Chile)]
*[[Jenniffer González Colón]] takes office as [[Governor of Puerto Rico]]. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/puerto-ricos-new-governor-takes-office-amid-anger-following-major-blackout (PBS)]
